answer.short_answer:
The metformin hydrochloride tablets label [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2] establishes that this product is indicated for adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus, to improve glycemic control as an adjunct to diet and exercise. In contrast, the metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets label [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-3] is indicated only for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

The ZITUVIMET label [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-1] is for a combination product containing sitagliptin and metformin hydrochloride, and it is indicated for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. This combination product has a different population qualifier than the metformin hydrochloride tablets label, which includes pediatric patients.

These labels do not provide information on the size of the benefit of metformin or the sitagliptin/metformin combination in improving glycemic control [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-2] [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-1] [openFDA label:FDA-LABEL-metformin-3].
